proof_control.lemma: If F:X->Y is L-Lipschitz between normed spaces and Frechet differentiable at x, then ||DF(x)||<=L. For any h, ||DF(x)h|| = lim_{t->0} ||F(x+th)-F(x)||/|t| <= L||h||. Hence every restriction DF(x)|_E also has operator norm <=L.
proof_control.consequence: No same-map same-norm differentiable example can satisfy global Lip(F)<1 and ||DF(x)|_E||>1.
proof_control.hodge_positive_disanalogy: For u=t^2, Q[u]->Q[t] is injective, so the affine scheme-theoretic image is all A1_u; at t=0 the cotangent map sends u mod u^2 to t^2 mod t^2=0, so df_0=0.
proof_control.scope: This proves only the transfer discriminator. It neither verifies Wilson's source hypotheses nor constructs a Yang-Mills stable manifold nor advances Hodge algebraicity.
